message.content:
Sure thing! To craft a trip that feels just right for you, could you let me know a bit more about your plans?

| What would help me tailor the itinerary? | Example answers |
|----------------------------------------|-----------------|
| **Trip length** (days you’ll spend in Paris) | 5 days, 7 days, weekend getaway, etc. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Spring (April–May), summer (June–August), fall (September–October), winter (December–January). |
| **Budget range** (per person, approximate) | €800–€1500, luxury, budget-friendly, etc. |
| **Interests** | Art & museums, food & wine, history, shopping, nightlife, day trips outside Paris, etc. |
| **Accommodation preference** | Hotel, boutique B&B, Airbnb, hostels, or a specific area (Le Marais, Latin Quarter, near the Eiffel Tower). |
| **Transportation** | Flights, train (e.g., Eurostar from London), car rental, public transit only. |
| **Special needs** | Accessibility, dietary restrictions, family-friendly, solo travel, etc. |

Once I have a bit more detail, I can put together a personalized schedule—including sights, dining spots, transport tips, and a rough budget breakdown. If you’re happy with a general “classic Paris” outline, just let me know and I’ll dive straight in!
